title: karpenter chart values (partial schema)
description: Validates the settings.flavors overrides and the boolean toggles at helm install/upgrade time, before a typo reaches the controller. Flavor entries are closed objects: the controller refuses the whole overrides file on a key it does not know (a typo, or the priceHourly that earlier releases accepted) and runs without any override, so such a key must fail the upgrade here instead. The booleans need typing because the templates gate on Go-template truthiness, where any non-empty string is true: a quoted "false" (--set-string, or a quoted values file) would render the exact opposite of its intent. Everything else is intentionally unconstrained, unknown keys included: values a past release consumed and a later one removed (settings.pricing) must keep rendering under `helm upgrade --reuse-values`.

enabled.description: Expose the metrics endpoint through a ClusterIP service.

disableLeaderElection.description: Disable leader election. The string "false" would still disable it — two active controllers with replicas>1.

name.description: Flavor name (e.g. 2XS..XL). A name outside the built-in catalogue introduces a new flavor and must also set cpu and memoryKi.
